prompt:
Goal: Create a realistic screenshot-style comparison image showing an AI-generated Apple-style product landing page inside a dark ChatGPT image result frame.

Canvas: Square 4:3 image, about 800×800 px, dark charcoal background. Add a thin rounded neon-green outline around the outer result container. At the very top center, include a small white speech-bubble pointer tab peeking down.

Outer frame: Dark UI container with rounded corners. Top bar height about 52 px. On the left show the OpenAI swirl icon and green monospace label “gpt-image-2 (medium)”. On the right show exactly 2 controls: a small download icon and a rounded “Edit” button with a pencil icon. Keep the interface minimal and dark.

Inner webpage: Center a large Apple-like homepage screenshot with black background, slightly inset from the outer frame. The webpage should be cropped so the far left and right edges are slightly cut off. At the top is a black navigation bar with exactly 8 visible menu items, spaced horizontally: “iPad” partially clipped on the far left, “iPhone”, “Watch”, “Vision”, “AirPods”, “TV & Home”, “Entertainment”, and “Accessories” partially clipped on the far right.

Hero section: Create an Apple-style product hero for “iPhone 17 Pro”. Place the small orange product name centered near the top. Below it, make a huge bold headline reading “PRO. BEYOND.” with a metallic silver-to-orange gradient, glossy dimensional lettering, and period marks after both words. Under the headline, include a two-line Spanish subtitle: “El iPhone más potente y avanzado hasta ahora.” and “Diseñado para lo que viene.” Below the subtitle place exactly 2 call-to-action links: a blue rounded button labeled “Más información” and a blue text link labeled “Comprar >”.

Product image: The bottom two-thirds of the webpage is dominated by a close-up macro render of an orange/copper iPhone back, cropped large so only the upper back and camera island are visible. Show exactly 3 raised black camera lenses in triangular arrangement on the left side of the camera plateau, exactly 1 silver circular flash near the upper right, exactly 1 tiny dot sensor below it, and exactly 1 black oval/circle sensor on the right. The phone has rounded corners, polished copper edges, realistic reflections, embossed Apple logo barely visible near the bottom center, and studio lighting.

Visual style: Hyper-realistic product render mixed with a clean web mockup, glossy Apple-like advertising aesthetics, high contrast black background, orange accents, sharp typography, no people.

Constraints: Preserve the Spanish text exactly as written, keep all counts exact, do not add extra buttons, icons, navigation labels, or product features, and avoid watermarks or captions outside the screenshot frame.

promptZh:
目标：创建一张逼真的截图风格对比图，展示一个 AI 生成的 Apple 风格产品落地页，并置于深色 ChatGPT 图像结果框架内。

画布：4:3 正方形图像，约 800×800 像素，深炭灰色背景。在外部结果容器周围添加一圈细细的圆角霓虹绿轮廓。在顶部正中央，包含一个向下探出的白色对话气泡指针标签。

外部框架：带有圆角的深色 UI 容器。顶部栏高度约 52 像素。左侧显示 OpenAI 漩涡图标和绿色等宽字体标签 “gpt-image-2 (medium)”。右侧精确显示 2 个控件：一个小下载图标和一个带有铅笔图标的圆角 “Edit” 按钮。保持界面简洁且为深色。

内部网页：居中放置一张大型 Apple 风格主页截图，背景为黑色，相对于外部框架略微内缩。网页应进行裁剪，使左右两侧边缘略微切除。顶部是一个黑色导航栏，包含 8 个可见的菜单项，水平排列：“iPad”（左侧部分被截断）、“iPhone”、“Watch”、“Vision”、“AirPods”、“TV & Home”、“Entertainment” 以及 “Accessories”（右侧部分被截断）。

主图区域：为 “iPhone 17 Pro” 创建一个 Apple 风格的产品主图。将小号橙色产品名称置于顶部附近居中位置。下方制作一个巨大的粗体标题，内容为 “PRO. BEYOND.”，采用金属银到橙色的渐变色，具有光泽的立体字体，且两个单词后均带有句号。在标题下方，包含两行西班牙语副标题：“El iPhone más potente y avanzado hasta ahora.” 和 “Diseñado para lo que viene.”。在副标题下方精确放置 2 个行动号召链接：一个标有 “Más información” 的蓝色圆角按钮，以及一个标有 “Comprar >” 的蓝色文本链接。

产品图像：网页的下三分之二由一张橙色/铜色 iPhone 背面的微距渲染图占据，裁剪比例较大，仅显示上部背面和摄像头模组。在摄像头平台左侧精确显示 3 个呈三角形排列的黑色凸起摄像头镜头，右上角附近精确显示 1 个银色圆形闪光灯，下方精确显示 1 个微型点状传感器，右侧精确显示 1 个黑色椭圆形/圆形传感器。手机具有圆角、抛光铜色边缘、逼真的反射效果、底部中心附近隐约可见的浮雕 Apple 标志，以及摄影棚灯光效果。

视觉风格：超写实产品渲染与简洁网页模型的结合，具有光泽的 Apple 风格广告美学，高对比度黑色背景，橙色点缀，清晰的排版，无人物。

约束条件：保留西班牙语文本原样，保持所有数量精确，不要添加额外的按钮、图标、导航标签或产品功能，并避免在截图框架外出现水印或标题。
